outcome: Diagnosis of definite neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC)
cohort: A total of 213 neonates with suspected necrotizing enterocolitis were collected from the neonatal department of a hospital.
finding: The application of abdominal color Doppler ultrasound provides high accuracy and sensitivity for NEC diagnosis and also contributes to its prognosis.
mod_finding: No differences were found in delivery modes between neonates who were NEC-positive and those who were NEC-negative.
